texts.greet: Systems online. I am VEGA. 11 robots are in the database. Ask me for a price, a height, or a comparison.
texts.empty: I'm listening. Ask me for a price, a height, or a comparison.
texts.help: You can ask me for a robot's profile, its price, height, weight or speed. I can also compare two robots, find the fastest or the cheapest, and read you the latest developments.
texts.fallback: I don't have that information in my database. Try with a robot's name, for example: introduce Atlas, or how much is the G1.
texts.nomic: Speech recognition is not available in this browser. Type your question, and I'll answer out loud.
texts.noheard: I didn't hear you. Try again, or type your question.
texts.compare: Comparison displayed. The two profiles are side by side.
texts.sources: The sources for this profile are listed below the figures. Each link opens the original document.
texts.journal: Here are the three latest entries in the timeline. September 21, 2026: Boston Dynamics opens a training center for Atlas at Hyundai. September 17, 2026: Figure says it tested its robot in 30 homes. September 3, 2026: Figure secures $3.5 billion of computing power.
texts.sum-g1: The G1 is Unitree's small humanoid: about one meter thirty, thirty-five kilos, and an announced launch price of sixteen thousand dollars. It is the robot most used in humanoid robot fights.
texts.height-g1: G1 is 1.30 meters tall. Note: about 130 cm according to Unitree.
texts.speed-g1: G1 reaches 2.0 meters per second, or about 7 kilometers per hour.
texts.dof-g1: G1 has 23 degrees of freedom. Note: up to 43 in the EDU version.
texts.price-g1: G1: 16,000 dollars. Note: price announced at launch, base version.
texts.sum-h1: The H1 is Unitree's adult-sized humanoid: one meter eighty, forty-seven kilos, and a claimed running speed of three point three meters per second, nearly twelve kilometers per hour.
texts.speed-h1: H1 reaches 3.3 meters per second, or about 12 kilometers per hour. Note: running speed claimed by Unitree.
texts.price-h1: H1: 90,000 dollars. Note: indicative public price, varies by reseller.
texts.sum-h2: The H2 is Unitree's new adult-sized humanoid, unveiled in October 2025: one meter eighty-two, about seventy kilos and thirty-one degrees of freedom. Unitree lists a price of twenty-nine thousand nine hundred dollars, excluding tax and shipping.
texts.weight-h2: H2 weighs 70 kilos. Note: including the battery.
texts.speed-h2: I don't have this figure for H2: it has not been disclosed.
texts.price-h2: H2: 29,900 dollars. Note: price listed by Unitree, excluding tax and shipping; EDU version on quote.
texts.sum-optimus: Optimus is Tesla's humanoid: one meter seventy-three for fifty-seven kilos. In summer 2026, it was not on sale: it only worked in Tesla factories. The price of twenty to thirty thousand dollars is a target, not a price tag.
texts.speed-optimus: Optimus reaches 2.2 meters per second, or about 8 kilometers per hour. Note: projected walking speed, not publicly measured. Careful, this figure is not confirmed.
texts.dof-optimus: I don't have this figure for Optimus: it has not been disclosed.
texts.price-optimus: Optimus has no selling price. The announced target is about 25,000 dollars. Note: announced price target ($20,000 to $30,000), not a selling price. Careful, this figure is not confirmed.
texts.sum-figure03: Figure 03 is about one meter seventy tall and weighs sixty kilos. Designed for the home, it is working in factories first: BMW deployed it in June 2026 at its Spartanburg plant, to sort parts.
texts.height-figure03: Figure 03 is 1.70 meters tall. Note: 1.68 to 1.73 m depending on the source.
texts.speed-figure03: Figure 03 reaches 1.2 meters per second, or about 4 kilometers per hour. Note: walking speed of about 4.3 km/h.
texts.dof-figure03: I don't have this figure for Figure 03: it has not been disclosed.
texts.price-figure03: I don't have this figure for Figure 03: it has not been disclosed.
texts.sum-atlas: Atlas, from Boston Dynamics, is the tallest in the database: one meter ninety, ninety kilos and fifty-six degrees of freedom. Its production version was unveiled in January 2026, and the whole year's production is already booked.
texts.speed-atlas: I don't have this figure for Atlas: it has not been disclosed.
texts.dof-atlas: Atlas has 56 degrees of freedom. Note: joints with full rotation.
texts.price-atlas: I don't have this figure for Atlas: it has not been disclosed.
texts.sum-digit: Digit is Agility's warehouse humanoid: one meter seventy-five, sixty-four kilos. It is one of the few humanoids already paid to work: it has moved one hundred thousand totes at the logistics company GXO.
texts.speed-digit: I don't have this figure for Digit: it has not been disclosed.
texts.dof-digit: I don't have this figure for Digit: it has not been disclosed.
texts.price-digit: I don't have this figure for Digit: it has not been disclosed. Note: offered for rent (robot as a service).
texts.sum-neo: NEO, from 1X, is a humanoid for the home: only thirty kilos, sold for twenty thousand dollars or four hundred ninety-nine dollars a month. It is not fully autonomous: for a task it does not know, a human operator can guide it remotely.
texts.height-neo: NEO is 1.68 meters tall. Note: height not published by the manufacturer. Careful, this figure is not confirmed.
texts.speed-neo: I don't have this figure for NEO: it has not been disclosed.
texts.dof-neo: I don't have this figure for NEO: it has not been disclosed.
texts.price-neo: NEO: 20,000 dollars. Note: or $499 per month as a subscription.
texts.sum-t800: EngineAI's T800 is the official robot of the URKL fighting league, launched in Shenzhen in 2026. One meter seventy-three, about eighty kilos, and an announced joint torque of up to four hundred fifty newton-meters.
texts.weight-t800: T800 weighs 80 kilos. Note: 75 to 85 kg depending on the edition.
texts.speed-t800: T800 reaches 3.0 meters per second, or about 11 kilometers per hour.
texts.dof-t800: T800 has 29 degrees of freedom. Note: 25 to 46 depending on the edition.
texts.price-t800: T800: 40,500 dollars. Note: $25,000 to $54,000 depending on the edition and the seller.
texts.sum-walker-s2: UBTech's Walker S2 is a factory humanoid: one meter seventy-six and seventy kilos according to the manufacturer. Its distinctive feature: it swaps its own battery, in about three minutes. Series production began in November 2025.
texts.height-walker-s2: Walker S2 is 1.76 meters tall. Note: some 2025 articles gave 1.62 m; 1.76 m according to UBTech's documentation.
texts.weight-walker-s2: Walker S2 weighs 70 kilos. Note: without the hands.
texts.speed-walker-s2: I don't have this figure for Walker S2: it has not been disclosed.
texts.dof-walker-s2: I don't have this figure for Walker S2: it has not been disclosed.
texts.price-walker-s2: I don't have this figure for Walker S2: it has not been disclosed.
texts.sum-apollo: Apollo, from Apptronik, is one meter seventy-three tall, weighs seventy-two kilos, and carries twenty-five kilos. Mercedes-Benz has been testing it since 2024, and the company raised five hundred twenty million dollars in February 2026.
texts.speed-apollo: I don't have this figure for Apollo: it has not been disclosed.
texts.dof-apollo: I don't have this figure for Apollo: it has not been disclosed.
texts.price-apollo: I don't have this figure for Apollo: it has not been disclosed.

texts.sup-shortest: Among the 10 robots for which I have this figure, the shortest is G1, from Unitree: 1.30 meters. Note: about 130 cm according to Unitree.
texts.sup-heaviest: Among the 11 robots for which I have this figure, the heaviest is Atlas, from Boston Dynamics: 90 kilos.
texts.sup-lightest: Among the 11 robots for which I have this figure, the lightest is NEO, from 1X: 30 kilos.
texts.sup-fastest: Among the 4 robots for which I have this figure, the fastest is H1, from Unitree: 3.3 meters per second, or about 12 kilometers per hour. Note: running speed claimed by Unitree.
texts.sup-cheapest: Among the 5 robots for which I have this figure, the cheapest is G1, from Unitree: 16,000 dollars. Note: price announced at launch, base version.
texts.sup-priciest: Among the 5 robots for which I have this figure, the most expensive is H1, from Unitree: 90,000 dollars. Note: indicative public price, varies by reseller.
